sentences.A: Signal A was recovered in the archival dry run (Sector 32) at the pre-registered times and depth (6 counted transits; measured false-detection level for this product about 0.47 % overall (26 of 5514 trials; binomial 95 % upper bound 0.65 %, approximate because the trials share data) and 0.52 % for exactly 6 counted transits (5 of 963; binomial bound 1.09 %)); robust (provisional until 2027-02-28); its pixel position is compatible with TIC 4206066 (empirical p = 0.1563 from 3000 on-target injections, not below 0.05).
sentences.B: The archival dry run (Sector 32) cannot decide on signal B (reason: no counted transit).

fixed_note: No combined statement about A and B or about the system is part of this test; any such statement is exploratory and cannot be cited for or against either outcome.
